description.zh-CN: 官方 Tier 2 原生插件：接入中国高校 Minecraft 联盟（MUA）联合皮肤站认证体系，支持成员皮肤站白名单同步、角色跨站绑定与改名同步、联合黑名单管理及 Union OAuth2 单点登录
description.en: Official Tier 2 native plugin integrating the Minecraft University Alliance (MUA) Union federation protocol: member skinDomains sync, cross-site player binding and lifecycle sync, union blacklist management, and Union OAuth2 SSO

description.zh-CN: MUA Union 中心节点 API 地址（必须使用 HTTPS，默认 https://skin.mualliance.ltd/api/union）
description.en: Base HTTPS URL of the MUA Union Hub API (default: https://skin.mualliance.ltd/api/union)

description.zh-CN: 向 MUA 联合认证申请成员站后获得的 X-Union-Member-Key 凭据，仅在服务端安全保存，不会暴露给浏览器前端
description.en: X-Union-Member-Key credential issued by MUA Union. Stored securely server-side and never exposed to browsers.

label.zh-CN: 启用 MUA Union OAuth2 单点登录

description.zh-CN: 开启后向 Union Hub 暴露 /api/union/member/oauth2 与 /api/union/member/oauth2/grant，自动管理 4096 位 RSA 签名密钥对
description.en: Exposes /api/union/member/oauth2 and /api/union/member/oauth2/grant to the Union Hub using an auto-managed 4096-bit RSA signing keypair.

label.zh-CN: 在进服时启用联合黑名单校验
label.en: Enforce Union Blacklist on Server Join

description.zh-CN: 开启后将在 yggdrasil.join 阶段查询 Union 联合黑名单，拒绝被封禁邮箱对应的账号加入游戏服务器
description.en: Queries the Union blacklist during yggdrasil.join and blocks blacklisted email accounts from joining game servers.

label.zh-CN: 允许 Union 远端回调轮换 Yggdrasil 签名私钥（高危）
label.en: Allow Remote Webhook to Rotate Yggdrasil Signing Key (High Risk)

description.zh-CN: 默认关闭。开启后允许通过 RSA 验签的 /api/union/member/updateprivatekey 回调自动同步 Union 统一签名私钥，所有操作均记入审计日志
description.en: Disabled by default. When enabled, RSA-verified /api/union/member/updateprivatekey webhooks may rotate the site's Yggdrasil signing key (audited).

label.zh-CN: 允许 Union 远端回调重映射角色 UUID（高危）
label.en: Allow Remote Webhook to Remap Player UUIDs (High Risk)

description.zh-CN: 默认关闭。开启后允许通过 RSA 验签的 /api/union/member/remapuuid 回调批量修改本地角色 UUID（跨站绑定/UUID 统一所需），所有操作均记入审计日志
description.en: Disabled by default. When enabled, RSA-verified /api/union/member/remapuuid webhooks may rewrite local player UUIDs for cross-site binding (audited).

label.zh-CN: 允许 Union 远端回调轮换成员站密钥（高危）
label.en: Allow Remote Webhook to Rotate Member Key (High Risk)

description.zh-CN: 默认关闭。开启后允许通过 RSA 验签的 /api/union/member/updatebackendkey 回调更新本地缓存的成员站密钥，所有操作均记入审计日志
description.en: Disabled by default. When enabled, RSA-verified /api/union/member/updatebackendkey webhooks may rotate the runtime member key (audited).

label.zh-CN: 向 Union 声明已启用联合邀请码能力

description.zh-CN: 开启后在 /api/union/member 的 enabledFeatures 中包含 invitationCodesForUnion

label.zh-CN: 用户页自定义说明（Markdown，留空则显示 Union 中心节点公告）
label.en: Custom User Page Introduction (Markdown, blank = use Hub description)
